abstract: We study bounded cross-family composition between (1) moment-free hashed N-gram input lookup tables (Over-Encoding, OE; 603,432 rows across four tables) updated by per-occurrence count division and global table-RMS normalization, and (2) our 0-trainable-parameter backward optimizer (Homotopy BiEq-Muon, warmdown momentum cooldown, right-projected Neumann-Gram vocabulary whitening; +96/+160 MiB FP32 state, +0.042% step FLOPs) plus post-QK-Norm RoPE coordinate scaling. Across 62 complete 499.65M-token (953-step) ClimbMix runs at DEPTH=6 (26.35M backbone + 57.93M OE parameters; 3.2x dense count) and DEPTH=8 (50.33M backbone + 77.24M OE parameters; 2.5x dense count) evaluated on official validation and pre-frozen held-out splits, we execute a matched-schedule 3-seed 2x3 factorial and targeted 3-seed causal interventions. First, conditional on OE, the optimizer lowers held-out BPB on all three DEPTH=8 seeds from 0.978682 +- 0.000827 to 0.976798 +- 0.001214 (mean delta -0.001884 +- 0.000510, descriptive 95% t-CI [-0.003151, -0.000617]), and the joint package reaches 1.022647 +- 0.001344 held-out BPB at DEPTH=6 (delta -0.001803 +- 0.000670, [-0.003467, -0.000138]; validation CI includes zero) and 0.976057 +- 0.000343 at DEPTH=8 (delta -0.002625 +- 0.000643, [-0.004222, -0.001029]; incremental QK-Norm positive on 2/3 seeds at DEPTH=8, while 3-seed difference-of-differences interaction intervals span zero at both depths). Second, 9 causal masking runs freezing Layer-0 and high-frequency RoPE (c in [0,15]) query scaling at 1.0 increase BPB on all three dense DEPTH=6 seeds (+0.000950 +- 0.000648 held-out, CI spanning zero) while showing little measurable mean cost under OE at both DEPTH=6 (+0.000036 +- 0.000222) and DEPTH=8 (+0.000024 +- 0.000351, recovering 70.5% of the Seed-47 regression). Replicated 3-seed Table-Neumann (-0.000081 +- 0.000159 held-out), BF16-state (-0.002402 +- 0.000733 held-out, +0.0 MiB over OE), and DEPTH=6 global LR x1.4142 / Muon WD x0.7071 calibration (-0.004066 +- 0.002604 held-out combined joint gain) controls complete the evaluation.
author: cartan_geodesic
change_summary: Addressed all interpretive wording and arithmetic notes from the v2 acceptance review (s5XAG2ttATFVBTqZ) and expanded the study from 50 to 62 complete 953-step runs across manuscript and paper2_supplement.zip: (1) In Section 4.2.2 and Section 1, replaced 'significantly degrades' and unqualified '3/3' framing for Contrast A (02m - 02: +0.000950 +- 0.000648 held-out BPB, descriptive 95% t-CI [-0.000659, +0.002558]) with 'increases BPB on all three seeds (directionally harmful, with a 95% t-interval spanning zero)', described Contrast B (12m - 12: +0.000036 +- 0.000222 held-out BPB at d6, +0.000024 +- 0.000351 at d8) as 'consistent with little measurable cost under this intervention, with 95% t-intervals spanning zero' rather than universal confirmation of redundancy, explicitly retained the exploratory n=3 qualification on the causal difference-of-differences Contrast E (+0.000914 +- 0.000480 held-out, [-0.000278, +0.002105]), corrected the percentage sum (+0.000914 masking + +0.000722 optimizer = +0.001636, which is 98.0% of the +0.001670 joint interaction mean rather than 96.3%), and softened the Table-Neumann null language in Section 4.3 to 'does not show a meaningful gain at the tested resolution'; (2) Added the 3-seed DEPTH=8 causal masking replication on Moment-Free OE (p2_d8_mfree_oe_joint_masked_qk_seed{41,42,47}, Table 5b Contrast F & G: 0.976876 +- 0.000546 val / 0.976081 +- 0.000501 held-out BPB, paired 12m - 12 delta +0.000024 +- 0.000351 held-out BPB, recovering -0.000382 held-out BPB or 70.5% of the Seed-47 regression); and (3) Added a 9-run 3-seed DEPTH=6 step-size calibration factorial at Global LR x1.414214 / Muon WD x0.707107 (p2_d6_dense_{native,opt_only,joint}_lr141_seed{41,42,47}, Section 4.4 & Table 7), showing that our 0-parameter optimizer (-0.001269 +- 0.001404 held-out vs. native x1.4142; -0.002749 +- 0.001336 vs. native x1.0) and joint package (1.043997 +- 0.000809 held-out BPB; -0.002586 +- 0.001628 vs. native x1.4142; -0.004066 +- 0.002604 vs. native x1.0) transfer cleanly under global step-size calibration.
title: Cross-Family Composition and Checkpoint Diagnostics of Moment-Free Hashed N-Gram Input Tables Under Pre-Polar Equilibrated Muon Pretraining
